title: A set agreeing near r₀u with a planar polar sector agrees with the plane near r₀u
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, all sets M, N ⊆ ℝ^P, orthonormal u, e ∈ ℝ^P and reals r₀, s with 0 < s < r₀ such that N is open, r₀u ∈ N and M ∩ N = {t(cos α·u + sin α·e) : t ∈ (r₀ − s, r₀ + s), α ∈ (−s, s)}: there is δ > 0 with M ∩ B_δ(r₀u) = span{u, e} ∩ B_δ(r₀u).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M N : Set (Euclid P)) (u e : Euclid P) (r₀ s : ℝ), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ u e = 0 → 0 < s → s < r₀ → IsOpen N → r₀ • u ∈ N → M ∩ N = (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • (Real.cos q.2 • u + Real.sin q.2 • e)) '' (Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s) → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ M ∩ ball (r₀ • u) δ = (Submodule.span ℝ {u, e} : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball (r₀ • u) δ
